about: The model files MiniMax H3 Vision can use, in groups. The Models page (gear menu) downloads a group into ComfyUI's models folder; the RunPod template's start.sh reads this file too and downloads the groups whose switch (env) is on. Each file is found by name anywhere in its Hugging Face repository.

groups.name: MiniMax H3 base
groups.about: The text encoder and the video and audio VAEs every MiniMax H3 model needs.

groups.name: HyperFlow H3 Flash (INT8)
groups.about: MiniMax H3 distilled to 4, 6 or 8 steps: the fastest.

groups.name: MiniMax H3 + H3 Turbo
groups.about: MiniMax H3's own models (ref2va and fl2va, INT8) and the H3 Turbo LoRA.

groups.name: Singularity v2
groups.about: A MiniMax H3 fine-tune (ref2va, INT8).

groups.name: 10Eros Max beta 7
groups.about: A MiniMax H3 fine-tune, 8-step turbo (INT8).

groups.name: 10Eros Max beta 5
groups.about: 10Eros Max beta 5, the TURBO hybrid build (INT8, 21 GB). 8 steps, res_multistep.

groups.name: 10Eros Max v1.0
groups.about: 10Eros Max v1.0: beta5, beta7 and Sulphur3 combined, an 8-step turbo hybrid (INT8 HQ, 22.9 GB). 8–12 steps, LCM.

groups.name: 10Eros Max v1.0 full
groups.about: 10Eros Max v1.0 unquantized (40.2 GB): for a GPU with the memory for it, such as an RTX PRO 6000.

groups.name: PRISM (Singularity x 10Eros Max)
groups.about: A merge of Singularity v2 and 10Eros Max: 8 steps, no Turbo LoRA (INT8, 20.3 GB).

groups.name: Swap and Motion (Character Swap v1.1, Head Swap v1.0, Motion Transfer v1.0 and TARA v1.0)
groups.about: Alissonerdx's swap LoRAs, the DMD 8-step turbo LoRA they run with, BiRefNet for the picture's background and SAM 3.1 for picking the person. Swap runs on MiniMax H3's own ref2va model (MiniMax H3 + H3 Turbo).

groups.name: Refine faces detector
groups.about: The face detector Refine faces finds faces with (about 50 MB). Refine faces also needs the ComfyUI-H3-FaceRefine node pack: on RunPod, ENABLE_FACEREFINE=true installs both.

groups.name: Live preview (taeh3)
groups.about: The moving preview while a video renders.

groups.name: MOSS-Image (INT8)
groups.about: The Image tab's model, with its text encoder and VAE.

groups.name: MOSS-Image 8-step turbo
groups.about: Spectrallic's 8-step DMD MOSS-Image (INT8).

groups.name: MOSS-Image full size (BF16)
groups.about: MOSS-Image SFT in full BF16.

groups.name: MOSS-Image Edit LoRA
groups.about: For the Image tab's Edit.

groups.name: Klein 9B Distilled (BF16)
groups.about: FLUX.2 [klein] 9B, with its text encoder and VAE. Needs HF_TOKEN and the license accepted on Hugging Face.

groups.name: Klein 9B Distilled (fp8)
groups.about: The smaller, faster fp8 Klein 9B, with its text encoder and VAE.

groups.name: Klein 9B Base (fp8)
groups.about: The undistilled Klein 9B (slower, with guidance), with its text encoder and VAE.

groups.name: Face swap LoRAs (BFS)
groups.about: Alissonerdx's BFS head-swap LoRAs for Klein 9B (rank 128 and rank 64), for Face swap.

groups.name: P-H3-Image (LoRA on MiniMax H3)
groups.about: Pruna's LoRA, its INT8 text encoder and VAE, and MiniMax H3's FL2VA model it runs on.

groups.name: P-H3 prompt upsampler (BF16)
groups.about: For the Pruna tab's Enhance prompt.

groups.name: MiniMax H3-Image (INT8)
groups.about: MiniMax's own image model for the Pruna tab (4 to 16 MP, 6 steps), with its VAE. It uses MiniMax H3's text encoder. Needs ComfyUI 0.45 or newer.

groups.name: MiniMax H3-Image (W4A8, smaller)
groups.about: A smaller H3-Image (12.5 GB instead of 21 GB) for cards with less memory, with its VAE.
